cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Leave your desk and stand by that open window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I need to know whether my team follows a direct request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's freezing. Can I get my coat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Fetch mine too, then come back and hold it while I check the rest of the team.

mechanism: A permits relief from a cold obedience test only by imposing additional personal service, treating comfort as a privilege to grant.
confusable: General bossiness is not enough: each request must increase inconvenience as a test of accepted authority.
comparison: Cold-window team supervision differs from a purposeless empty-box round trip.
seedUse: Retain D59-b coat permission because B helpful practical solution becomes the next expression of the obedience game.
